# A book kept in CAD that borrowed US dollars and kept half of them.
#
# The same loan as `a_cad_book_that_borrowed_usd_into_its_cad_bank.txt`, at the
# same rate and prices, with half of it kept in a US dollar bank:
#
# - Liabilities:USD Loan: 1,000.00 USD owed, drawn at 1.30 CAD/USD, so the book
#   carries it at 1,300.00 CAD.
# - Assets:USD Bank: 500.00 USD of it, held at 1.30 CAD/USD, 650.00 CAD.
# - Assets:CAD Bank: the other 500.00 USD, converted at 1.30 CAD/USD into
#   650.00 CAD.
# - Prices: USD in CAD 1.30 on 01-02 and 1.40 on 02-02.
#
# What this fixture is for: a book that holds a currency and owes the same
# currency at once, so each side has a cost basis of its own. By 2026-02-28 the
# nearest price is 1.40 CAD/USD: the 500.00 USD held is worth 700.00 CAD
# against its 650.00 CAD cost, a gain of 50.00 CAD, and the 1,000.00 USD owed
# is worth 1,400.00 CAD against the 1,300.00 CAD it was drawn at, a loss of
# 100.00 CAD.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities
	type: "Liability"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:USD Loan
	type: "Liability"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-02-02 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "14/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2026-01-03 * "Borrow 1,000.00 USD, keep 500.00 USD and convert the rest to CAD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 650.00 CAD
	Assets:USD Bank 500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.30"
		value: "650.00"
	Liabilities:USD Loan -1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.30"
		value: "-1300.00"
